failure_reason: Akamai Bot Manager CPR_Block soft-blocks every /c/* category/listing page (returns a static 'Site Maintenance' error page, ~1109 bytes, both via curl_cffi safari17_0 impersonation and via WebFetch from Anthropic infra), matching the block already documented in the prior Home-Decor/Furniture pass note for this company. Only the root-level static sitemaps (robots.txt, sitemap-index.xml, sitemap-category.xml) are reachable; they proved the Pet Care category exists but carry no product-count data, so qty could not be verified.
notes: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only generic User-agent:* rules and a Pinterestbot group), so a full access-tier sweep was performed. Tier 1: curl_cffi impersonate=safari17_0 succeeded (200) on robots.txt (2233 bytes), sitemap-index.xml (11120 bytes) and sitemap-category.xml (15434 bytes), but the homepage and every /c/* category URL returned the site's Akamai 'CPR_Block' maintenance page (~1109 bytes, title 'Site Maintenance'). Tried the one candidate Pet Care URL directly (https://www.lampsplus.com/c/home-accessories/type_pets/) - same CPR_Block page. Tier 3 check via WebFetch (Anthropic infra) on the same URL also returned the identical CPR_Block/maintenance page, confirming the block is not IP-specific. Per Rule 1 (first block stops the host), did not attempt Playwright/CDP or Claude-in-Chrome once the pattern was confirmed on two independent routes/infra, and did not retry the host further. Grepped sitemap-category.xml (the full canonical category list, ~230 URLs) for pet-related terms: exactly one match, /c/home-accessories/type_pets/ - a 'type_' facet node under the Home Accessories umbrella, same URL pattern used for other genuinely-different-product-type facets in the prior Home-Decor pass (type_vases, type_wall-clocks, type_sculptures, etc.), so this is treated as a real, distinct leaf category, not a nested attribute of another product. WebSearch corroborates the category is real and pet-specific: a Pinterest-indexed Lamps Plus product listing titled 'Uttermost Lucky Pet Bed - #N4217 | Lamps Plus' confirms pet beds are actually sold under this line. Also found in the same sitemap a sibling node /c/home-accessories/type_bird-houses-and-feeders/ - considered and EXCLUDED as Pet Care: in a home-decor/lighting retailer's Home Accessories line this is standard outdoor/garden decor for wild birds (attracting birds to a yard), not a product for an owned pet, consistent with the Tier-1/Tier-2 boundary rules (no owned-pet purpose established). No product-level sitemap or JSON API was reachable to source a qty for type_pets (same Akamai protection layer per the prior pass's documentation), so qty is null and the row is flagged for manual review rather than guessed. status is 'partial' (not 'blocked') because sitemap evidence did positively establish the category's existence and URL, even though its qty is unverifiable this session.
